title: Full Historical Price / Fill Predictive Atlas

scope.primary: identity-blind scalar prediction from canonical transaction prices and anonymous fill/activity history

datasets.data_001_use: canonical mappings/provenance only when necessary; book coverage is never an inclusion requirement

trade_reconstruction.required_group_shape: exactly one active-order row and one or more passive-order rows
trade_reconstruction.economic_trade_rows: passive rows; active aggregate row is audit-only and never counted as another trade
trade_reconstruction.multi_maker: each passive leg is one economic fill in deterministic timestamp, tx_hash, log_index order
conservation: active size equals summed passive size within tolerance
active YES-axis notional equals summed passive YES-axis notional within tolerance
trade_reconstruction.alpha_prohibition: role, fee and participant fields may be used only for reconstruction/audit and are removed before feature construction

features.large_trade_threshold: TRAIN-only q90 of economic-trade shares within market; family fallback for markets with fewer than 100 TRAIN trades
features.activity_history_reference: TRAIN-only median 60-second trade count per market; family fallback

targets.clock_asof: last economic trade at or before t+h, valid only if at least one later economic trade occurs in (t,t+h]; otherwise NO_FUTURE_OBSERVATION
targets.observed_no_movement: later economic trade exists and resulting change equals zero
targets.label_end_time: timestamp of selected future clock observation or Nth future economic trade

splits.method: per-family synchronized chronological boundaries across all markets
splits.boundary_basis: family timestamp coverage only, never performance
splits.purge: discard TRAIN/DEV rows whose label_end_time is at or beyond the next split boundary
splits.holdout_rule: no feature, threshold or hyperparameter selection uses HOLDOUT

redundancy.representative_rule: highest median absolute TRAIN rank association across supported targets, ties lexicographically

dev_selection.stability_rule: direction agrees TRAIN to DEV in claimed scope and no single market contributes more than 50% of supported rows

model_ladder.preprocessing: TRAIN-fit median imputation and standardization for linear models; no target-derived transforms
model_ladder.selection: hyperparameters selected on DEV only; frozen shortlist evaluated once on HOLDOUT

uncertainty.primary: family to market hierarchical bootstrap plus calendar-time moving blocks

negative_controls: current absolute movement versus subsequent movement
activity predicting contemporaneous movement versus subsequent movement
within-market circular time-block feature permutation preserving missingness

compute.launch_rule: launch only while fewer than three shared Kaggle jobs are running or queued
